name: comprehensive_benchmark_fleet_marketplace
description: Comprehensive benchmark for a fleet/mobility marketplace dataset (DK schema). Default: geometric adstock only. Tests cartesian product of 5 dimensions: adstock × train_splits × time_aggregation × spend_var_mapping × seasonality_window (90 variants). Use run_full_benchmark.py --all-adstock to also sweep weibull_cdf and weibull_pdf (270 variants). Designed for the DK fleet/marketplace dataset with Google Search (brand, non-brand_2, pmax_2, other_2), Bing (brand, non-brand, other), and FB sub-channels (upper, lower, app). paid_media_spends = [GOOGLE_SEARCH_BRAND_COST, GOOGLE_SEARCH_NONBRAND_COST_2, GOOGLE_PMAX_COST_2, GOOGLE_OTHER_COST_2, BING_SEARCH_BRAND_COST, BING_SEARCH_NONBRAND_COST, BING_OTHER_COST, FB_UPPER_COST, FB_LOWER_COST, FB_APP_COST]. spend_var_mapping variants test spend-only, impressions-proxy, clicks-proxy, and mixed-by-funnel (FB_UPPER as upper funnel, rest as lower funnel).

adstock.name: geometric
adstock.description: Geometric adstock (default — use --all-adstock to also test weibull_cdf and weibull_pdf)

spend_var_mapping.name: spend_to_spend
spend_var_mapping.description: All channels: spend → spend (direct cost impact). paid_media_vars equals paid_media_spends.

spend_var_mapping.name: spend_to_impressions
spend_var_mapping.description: Priority-1 channels: spend → impressions (ad delivery proxy). Assumes paid_media_spends = [meta, google_brand, google_nonbrand, google_pmax, google_display, google_youtube, bing_brand, bing_nonbrand, bing_other]. Column order must match paid_media_spends in selected_columns.json.

spend_var_mapping.name: spend_to_clicks
spend_var_mapping.description: Priority-1 channels: spend → clicks (engagement proxy). Assumes paid_media_spends = [meta, google_brand, google_nonbrand, google_pmax, google_display, google_youtube, bing_brand, bing_nonbrand, bing_other]. Column order must match paid_media_spends in selected_columns.json.

spend_var_mapping.name: mixed_by_funnel_impressions
spend_var_mapping.description: Upper funnel (video, display, social) → impressions; lower funnel (brand/non-brand search, pmax, bing) → spend. Assumes paid_media_spends = [meta, google_brand, google_nonbrand, google_pmax, google_display, google_youtube, bing_brand, bing_nonbrand, bing_other]. Column order must match paid_media_spends in selected_columns.json.

spend_var_mapping.name: mixed_by_funnel_clicks
spend_var_mapping.description: Upper funnel (video, display, social) → clicks; lower funnel (brand/non-brand search, pmax, bing) → spend. Assumes paid_media_spends = [meta, google_brand, google_nonbrand, google_pmax, google_display, google_youtube, bing_brand, bing_nonbrand, bing_other]. Column order must match paid_media_spends in selected_columns.json.

seasonality_window.name: full
seasonality_window.description: Full data window (all available history — no start_date override)

seasonality_window.name: 2y
seasonality_window.description: Last 2 years (~104 weeks back from end_date)

seasonality_window.name: 3y
seasonality_window.description: Last 3 years (~156 weeks back from end_date)
